findings.motion: HB 219, a person submitting proof of citizenship to verify eligibility to vote in Texas
findings.note: Bill filed by Landgraf. An applicant would have to present proof of U.S. citizenship to register: a REAL ID-compliant Texas driver's license or ID card, a birth certificate, a U.S. passport, or a naturalization or citizenship certificate. Referred to the Elections committee 2025-02-27; no later action shown.

findings.passage: “From smarter testing and youth-camp safety to flood warnings and election integrity, I was proud to advance legislation to protect families, improve transparency, and uphold our communities’ values.”
findings.note: Quote in his campaign-site wrap-up of the second called session of 2025; he lists election integrity among the areas where he advanced legislation but names no bill on it.

findings.passage: “The election integrity bill that I voted for increases penalties for 25 different forms of voter fraud/election tampering. It’s the biggest crackdown on voter fraud in Texas history!”
findings.note: His Facebook reply to a constituent, quoted by Odessa Headlines, defending his vote for the 2021 election law; the story says a floor amendment to that law also lowered the penalty for ineligible voting.
subjects: penalties for voter fraud / illegal voting
